mapper.select: SELECT JBGD_CD AS jbgdCd, JBGD_NM AS jbgdNm, JBGD_ORDR AS jbgdOrdr, USE_YN AS useYn, DATE_FORMAT(REGIST_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS registDt, DATE_FORMAT(UPDT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updtDt FROM hrm_pos_master ORDER BY JBGD_ORDR ASC, CASE WHEN USE_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC

SELECT JBGD_CD AS jbgdCd, JBGD_NM AS jbgdNm, JBGD_ORDR AS jbgdOrdr, USE_YN AS useYn, DATE_FORMAT(REGIST_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS registDt, DATE_FORMAT(UPDT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updtDt FROM hrm_pos_master WHERE JBGD_CD = #{jbgdCd}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hrm_pos_master WHERE JBGD_CD = #{jbgdCd}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hrm_emp_master WHERE JBGD_CD = #{jbgdCd} AND EMP_STTS_CD IN ('ACTIVE', 'LOA')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hrm_pos_master ( JBGD_CD, JBGD_NM, JBGD_ORDR, USE_YN ) VALUES ( #{jbgdCd}, #{jbgdNm}, #{jbgdOrdr}, IFNULL(#{useYn}, 'Y') )
